Top of Mind (https://topofmind.cloud) | AI Software Engineer, Marketing Engineer | REMOTE (EU timezone) | Full-time

We're building relationship intelligence. Not another CRM, not another note-taking app. Top of Mind turns conversations, meetings, and interactions into structured knowledge you can actually act on. A knowledge layer between raw information and real understanding. Small team, shipping fast, AI-augmented everything (we use Claude Code daily).

Hiring two roles, both remote in EU timezone.

AI Software Engineer — React Native, Expo, Claude Code. You'll build the core product. High ownership, small team, no playbook needed.

Marketing Engineer — B2C marketing, content, growth. Technical enough to build, creative enough to tell the story.

https://topofmind.cloud/careers
